description: Allowance Check (Base): how much can this spender move from this wallet right now? Reads the live ERC-20 allowance and the owner's balance: UNLIMITED (risk HIGH) / COVERS_FULL_BALANCE / LIMITED / NO_ALLOWANCE, with a safe next action and the exact revoke call (approve(spender, 0)). Optional intended_usd says whether a stablecoin allowance covers your next payment. For agents before approving, paying through a contract, or cleaning up old approvals. Public chain data, never signs. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/allowance, $0.002 via x402.)
